scope.en: 462 muscle/part meshes +47 support meshes;41 inherited topology warnings. Static illustrative surfaces, no rig or watertightness claim.

gateInterpretation: Historical scoped acceptance only; no new quality, anatomy, clinical, motion, count or runtime promotion.
limitations: 462 muscle/part meshes plus 47 support meshes; not complete anatomy or validated attachments.
41 inherited topology warnings; no watertightness, rigging, measured fibre direction or mechanics claim.
Static illustrative surfaces in Z-Anatomy native frame; do not silently overlay CT/BP3D assemblies.

failureSummary.change: Named source muscle collection with separate support classification and source-preserving modifier evaluation.
failureSummary.remaining: Source topology warnings and simplified surfaces remain.
failureSummary.lesson: Source selection and visible anatomy review precede surface polish; topology warnings must survive packaging.
